# Herzog Medical

> Herzog Medical specializes in scientifically-proven compression wear and recovery systems designed for athletes, sports recovery, and therapeutic medical applications.

Herzog Medical offers a comprehensive range of compression products including socks, tubes, shorts, arm sleeves, and thigh supports across PRO and Support lines. The company also provides advanced recovery technology through their Compry Recovery systems and Recovery Gun, all backed by clinical research and customer reviews.
